name: TestMyApps
description: New personal Google Play developer accounts must have 12 testers opted in for 14 continuous days before they get production access. TestMyApps supplies "14 real testers for 16 days", two testers and two days above the minimum. It coordinates the official opt-ins, monitors participation daily, replaces dropouts and writes a closeout report for your production-access application (company-stated). Pricing: Standard $15 / $29, Functionality $50 / $99. Free retest, then a full refund if still not approved. Claims a "99.9% approval rate" and notes that "Google makes the final production-access decision" (company-stated). The site is translated into 16 languages and cross-sells "StoreShots AI".
